title: Obesity, morbid obesity and BMI
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's weight diagnosis and BMI, if reportable.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for weight management.

HPI
Pt is a 61 y/o male presenting for routine follow-up. Pt reports difficulty with weight loss despite attempts at lifestyle modification. He notes some fatigue but no acute concerns. He is seeking guidance on diet and activity counseling.

Medication List
Multivitamin daily.

Exam
Vitals: BP 132/82, HR 78, RR 16, Temp 98.6 F, BMI 37.4.
Gen: Well-appearing, in no acute distress.
CV: RRR, CTAB.
Lungs: Clear to auscultation.
Ext: No edema noted.

Assessment
1. Obesity.

Plan
1. Obesity: Provided comprehensive diet and activity counseling. Pt advised to increase daily caloric expenditure and focus on low-calorie, nutrient-dense foods. Encouraged consistent physical activity 3-5x per week. F/u in 3 months to monitor progress.

Electronically signed, K. Nguyen, DO, 05/12/2026
explanations: Obesity documented by the provider: E66.9. The coder does not upgrade it to morbid obesity from the BMI.
BMI 37.x with a provider weight diagnosis: add Z68.37.

distractors.why: Only the provider can diagnose morbid obesity; the BMI does not change the diagnosis.
The BMI is documented and the provider diagnosed the weight condition: add the Z68 code.
